results.content: # 2026 International Conference on Humanities, Literature and Art Appreciation. # - About to ICHLAA 2026 ! The 2026 International Conference on Humanities, Literature, and Art Appreciation (ICHLAA 2026) is about to be held in Xiamen, the dazzling pearl on the southeast coast of China. This conference aims to bring together scholars, artists, critics, and educators from around the world in the humanities field to jointly explore the cutting-edge developments and future trends in humanities, literary creation, and art appreciation. ICHLAA 2026 is committed to building a high-level international academic platform to promote the innovative development of humanities and the popularization and deepening of art appreciation. All full paper submissions to the ICHLAA 2026 could be written in English and will be sent to at least two reviewers and evaluated based on originality, technical or research content or depth, correctness, relevance to conference, contributions, and readability. All accepted papers of ICHLAA 2026 will be published in the conference proceedings, which will be submitted to EI Compendex, Scopus for indexing.
